visual_action: The video opens with a black-and-white, still photograph of Joe Biden looking thoughtfully out of a window. After a few seconds, it cuts to a man in a blue suit (Lee Zeldin) speaking at a podium with the Seal of the President of the United States. He is in an ornate, gold-and-white room, gesturing towards two large presentation boards on easels. One board is titled 'The Trump Deregulatory Agenda' and the other resembles a large receipt.

cast.name: Joe Biden
cast.evidence: A photo of him is shown at the start of the video, with on-screen text that reads, 'The Biden administration's ridiculous regulations cost Americans billions.'

cast.name: Lee Zeldin
cast.evidence: He is the person shown speaking at the podium, presenting the information on the charts.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: His administration is praised in on-screen text ('Today's actions under Trump's admin') and on a large chart titled 'The Trump Deregulatory Agenda'.

on_screen_text.text: The Biden administration's ridiculous regulations cost Americans billions.
Today's actions under Trump's admin are saving over $2.4B for American families & safe-guarding over 350,000 jobs.

spoken_summary: Lee Zeldin, speaking from a podium, states that 'today's actions' are saving American families over $2.4 billion and safeguarding 350,000 jobs. He specifies that supermarkets alone will see savings of $800 million, which Americans will notice when they buy food.
audio_music: The video begins with a slow, somber piano and music box track for the first four seconds over the image of Joe Biden, creating a suspenseful or negative mood. The music then cuts out completely and is replaced by the clear, unadorned audio of the man speaking for the rest of the clip.
editing_pacing: The video has slow pacing, consisting of a static black-and-white photograph followed by a single cut to a static shot of a person speaking at a podium.
central_claim: The Biden administration's regulations are financially harming Americans, in contrast to the Trump administration's deregulatory policies which save families billions of dollars and protect jobs.
intended_effect: To persuade viewers that the Trump administration's economic policies are superior and more beneficial to American families than those of the Biden administration.
